changeSet.sql:
IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT * FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.TABLES WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA = 'dbo' AND TABLE_NAME = 'AssetTypeExportTemplate') BEGIN CREATE TABLE [dbo].[AssetTypeExportTemplate]( [ID] [int] IDENTITY(1,1) NOT NULL, [AssetTypeID] [int] NOT NULL, [Name] [nvarchar](250) NOT NULL, [Description] [nvarchar](max) NULL, [IncludeFields] [nvarchar](1000) NULL, [ExportViewType] [int] NULL, [IncludeParent] [bit] CONSTRAINT [DF_AssetTypeExportTemplate_IncludeParent] DEFAULT (0) NOT NULL, [IncludeUrl] [bit] CONSTRAINT [DF_AssetTypeExportTemplate_IncludeUrl] DEFAULT (0) NOT NULL, [TemplateFile] [varbinary](max) NULL, [CreatedOn] [datetime] NULL, [CreatedBy] [int] NULL, [UpdatedOn] [datetime] NULL, [UpdatedBy] [int] NULL, [UsageNotes] [nvarchar](max) NULL, CONSTRAINT [PK_AssetTypeExportTemplate] PRIMARY KEY NONCLUSTERED ( [ID] ASC ) ) END
IF NOT EXISTS (select * from sys.foreign_keys where name = 'FK_AssetTypeExportTemplate_AssetType') BEGIN ALTER TABLE [dbo].[AssetTypeExportTemplate] WITH CHECK ADD CONSTRAINT [FK_AssetTypeExportTemplate_AssetType] FOREIGN KEY([AssetTypeID]) REFERENCES [dbo].[AssetType] ([ID]) ALTER TABLE [dbo].[AssetTypeExportTemplate] CHECK CONSTRAINT [FK_AssetTypeExportTemplate_AssetType] END
IF COL_LENGTH('dbo.AssetTypeExportTemplate', 'uid') IS NULL BEGIN ALTER TABLE dbo.AssetTypeExportTemplate ADD uid uniqueidentifier not null constraint DF_AssetTypeExportTemplate_Uid default newid() END
changeSet.rollback: IF COL_LENGTH('dbo.AssetTypeExportTemplate', 'uid') IS NOT NULL BEGIN ALTER TABLE dbo.AssetTypeExportTemplate DROP CONSTRAINT DF_AssetTypeExportTemplate_Uid ALTER TABLE dbo.AssetTypeExportTemplate DROP COLUMN uid END
